limitations: Research reference candidate only; not a diagnostic or treatment model.
DE-CTA normalized perfused blood volume is a perfusion surrogate, not a direct dynamic flow measurement.
The lobar fractions multiply separately reported cohort medians of lobe volume and normalized PBV; they are not subject-level median iodine-content fractions.
The Lee cohort consisted of suspected-PE patients negative for PE and without cardiopulmonary comorbidity, not prospectively recruited healthy volunteers.
All beds currently share the aggregate 6.4 s transit because no qualified lobe-specific transit series was identified.
Lobar fractions are fixed across posture, exercise, gravity, disease, and age; recruitment and autoregulation are not represented.
Aggregate pressure-flow validation is inherited by exact network equivalence to v4; independent lobar validation remains open.
The conserved-transfer coupling remains aggregate while individual entities traverse an explicit deterministic lobe path.
Gas exchange, biochemical exchange, pulsatility, disease, and patient-specific anatomy remain outside this version.
